attempts.text: [{"name": "i_conv7", "idea": "Item conversion over the last 7 days of history: smoothed share of the item's sessions with a cart, with an order, and the share of carting sessions that also ordered.", "kind": "feature", "level": "item", "sql": "WITH h AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400 GROUP BY session, item), a AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n, sum(c) AS nc, sum(o) AS nor, sum(c * o) AS nco FROM h GROUP BY item) SELECT item, (nc + 0.1) / (n + 10.0) AS ag_i_cart_rate, (nor + 0.03) / (n + 10.0) AS ag_i_order_rate, (nco + 1.0) / (nc + 3.0) AS ag_i_c2o FROM a;"}, {"name": "i_trend", "idea": "Item momentum: last-day share of its 7-day history sessions, target-week prefix sessions relative to 7-day history sessions, and the share of its target-week prefixes with a cart or order.", "kind": "feature", "level": "item", "sql": "WITH hh AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ts >= {S} - 86400 THEN session END) AS d1, count(DISTINCT session) AS d7 FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400 GROUP BY item), w AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS wk, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event <> 'view' THEN session END) AS wb FROM sess GROUP BY item), k AS (SELECT item FROM hh UNION SELECT item FROM w) SELECT k.item, (coalesce(hh.d1, 0) + 1.0) / (coalesce(hh.d7, 0) + 7.0) AS ag_i_trend1, (coalesce(w.wk, 0) + 1.0) / (coalesce(hh.d7, 0) + 5.0) AS ag_i_wk_ratio, (coalesce(w.wb, 0) + 0.1) / (coalesce(w.wk, 0) + 5.0) AS ag_i_wk_buy_share FROM k LEFT JOIN hh ON hh.item = k.item LEFT JOIN w ON w.item = k.item;"}, {"name": "i_age", "idea": "Item freshness in the last 7 days of history: age of its first and last event before the week start and age of its last order.", "kind": "feature", "level": "item", "sql": "SELECT item, CAST(max({S} - ts) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_first_age, CAST(min({S} - ts) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_last_age, CAST(min(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN {S} - ts END) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_last_order_age FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400 GROUP BY item;"}, {"name": "p_state", "idea": "Prefix state of each history candidate: type of its last event, whether it sits in an open cart (carted after its last order or never ordered), and the number of separate visits (runs) to it.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.event, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.session ORDER BY x.seq, x.item) AS rn, lag(x.item) OVER (PARTITION BY x.session ORDER BY x.seq, x.item) AS pv FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), g AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN seq END) AS lc, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN seq END) AS lo, arg_max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 2 WHEN event = 'cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, rn) AS lt, sum(CASE WHEN pv IS NULL OR pv <> item THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS runs FROM s GROUP BY session, item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(g.lt AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_last_type, CASE WHEN g.item IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN g.lc IS NOT NULL AND (g.lo IS NULL OR g.lo < g.lc) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS ag_p_open_cart, CAST(g.runs AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_runs FROM cand c LEFT JOIN g ON g.session = c.session AND g.item = c.item;"}, {"name": "link_support", "idea": "Breadth of support for a candidate: summed conditional co-visitation probability from the last 10 distinct prefix items (integer-exact), and the number of distinct prefix items linking to it through any accepted table and through buy tables only.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), pt AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp <= 10), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM pt), dg AS (SELECT c.item, sum(c.tv_ns) AS tot FROM tb_covis_any7 c JOIN ki ON ki.item = c.item GROUP BY c.item), cv AS (SELECT pt.session, c.item2 AS item, sum(CAST(round(1000000.0 * c.tv_ns / dg.tot) AS BIGINT)) AS v FROM pt JOIN tb_covis_any7 c ON c.item = pt.item JOIN dg ON dg.item = pt.item GROUP BY pt.session, c.item2), lk AS (SELECT pt.session, c.item2 AS item, pt.item AS src, 0 AS b FROM pt JOIN tb_covis_any7 c ON c.item = pt.item UNION ALL SELECT pt.session, n.item2, pt.item, 0 FROM pt JOIN tb_next_any14 n ON n.item = pt.item UNION ALL SELECT pt.session, b.item2, pt.item, 1 FROM pt JOIN tb_buy2buy b ON b.item = pt.item UNION ALL SELECT pt.session, v.item2, pt.item, 1 FROM pt JOIN tb_view2cart v ON v.item = pt.item UNION ALL SELECT pt.session, o.item2, pt.item, 1 FROM pt JOIN tb_any2order o ON o.item = pt.item), ln AS (SELECT session, item, count(DISTINCT src) AS n, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b = 1 THEN src END) AS nb FROM lk GROUP BY session, item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(cv.v AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 AS ag_cov_cond, CAST(ln.n AS DOUBLE) AS ag_link_cnt, CAST(ln.nb AS DOUBLE) AS ag_link_buy_cnt FROM cand c LEFT JOIN cv ON cv.session = c.session AND cv.item = c.item LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.session = c.session AND ln.item = c.item;"}]
